authority.requiredCheck: Type, content, security, build and route checks

requiredGates: one approved low-risk R2 proposal with complete evidence, measurement and articleQualityReview score of at least 85
typecheck, lint, unit tests, dependency audit, build and prerender
route, canonical, sitemap, noindex, schema, accessibility and Lighthouse checks
forbidden: publishing more or fewer than one article in one automated change
merging after any failed or missing gate
recording a human as the automated proposal approver
